method: Photon Monte Carlo in the 30 cm water cube (4e6 emitted photons, pyramid source, Phi0=1/(Omega*110^2), Omega=0.009975 sr). Interactions: XCOM cross sections, Klein-Nishina Compton, Rayleigh, photoelectric, pair with two 511 keV annihilation photons. Fluence, spectra and angular distributions are track-length tallies in the 1 cm x 0.2 cm cylinder at 10 cm. Primary fluence is analytic (exp(-mu*10)). Interaction fractions come from fluence times process coefficients. Electron sources come from in-volume interactions (KN kinematics for Compton). Layer 4 uses CSDA with ESTAR stopping powers, Moller delta rays and Highland multiple scattering in an infinite medium. Kerma uses ESTAR radiation yields. Depth dose is the Kcol profile convolved with a depth-deposition kernel from electron transport, including the inverse-square primary term, giving dmax 0.7 cm and PDD(5) 83%. Spencer-Attix uses Bethe/Moller restricted stopping powers with a track-end term. Layer 3 and Layer 4 energy spectra are approximate estimates, not full tallies.
data_sources: /tmp/data/xcom_water.txt (XCOM-based coherent, incoherent, photoelectric, pair coefficients for water; 2 MeV total with coherent 0.04931 cm2/g). /tmp/data/estar_water.txt (ESTAR collision and radiative stopping powers, CSDA range, radiation yield, density effect). Air Spencer-Attix stopping powers computed from Bethe with I=85.7 eV, Z/A=0.49919 (no air data file). Moller cross sections and Klein-Nishina formulae analytic.
